name: YJ YuLong 3x3 V3 M (UV Coated + Clicky)
description: The YJ YuLong 3x3 V3 M (UV Coated + Clicky) is a budget-friendly magnetic speedcube with a glossy UV finish for improved grip and durability. Each turn produces a distinct click, giving the cube a tactile and audible feel that's satisfying and unique. Its strong factory-installed magnets help with layer alignment and control, making it a great choice for casual solvers or collectors.
